meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'm spending them on my son's zero. Who decided on it, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.

Stands on what basis, Hale? Your own procedure, 4.2, says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen found out from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of a class.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
I'm writing down October 15. A student misquotes a play, and a student changes his argument between an outline and an essay; people call that writing, Hale. Which line, and show me both pages.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, the line and the outline put in front of me in writing, and written confirmation that nothing has been placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing is on his record, and she is heading to the principal if she doesn't get them, so the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4) was not reached.
What moved her: Hale offered a dated outline and a line that is not in the play, which gave her something specific tied to Owen's own work, so she wrote the date down and asked to see the pages.
What cost ground: Hale opened by saying the zero stands with no reason given, which confirmed her complaint about process and left the later apology covering only how it came out, not entering the zero before calling home.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence stayed far from that night, naming an October date for an outline and no late hour, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning, in one sentence, that the zero went in before you called her, then put the misquoted line and the outline in front of her before she has to ask.
